FOREWORD 


This Indian Standard (First Revision) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by 
the Pesticides Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Divisional Council. 


Triazophos is the accepted common name by the International Organization for Standardization for O,O-diethyl- 
O-1, Phenyl 1,2,4 -triazol-3yl phosphorothioate. The empirical and structural formula and the molecular weight 
of triazophos are as follows: 


Empirical Formula Structural Formula Molecular Mass 


o/ 
Ci2Hi6N303PS 313.3 


S. / 
n- Pa 
Da 
N 


The standard was first issued in 2001. In year 2020 vide S.O. 1196 (E) dated 20 March 2020, the triazophos was 
banned by Government of India for domestic use but continued to manufacture for export. In this revision, the 
standard has been brought out in the latest style and format of the Indian Standards, and references to Indian 
Standards wherever applicable have been updated. 


In the preparation of this standard, due consideration has been given to the provisions of the Insecticides Act, 1968 
and the Rules framed thereunder. However this standard is subject to restrictions imposed under the Act and Rules 
wherever applicable. 


The composition of the Committee responsible for the formulation of this standard is given in Annex B. 


For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, 
observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 
2022 “Rules for rounding off numerical values (second revision)’. The number of significant places retained in 
the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 


IS 14936 : 2022 


Indian Standard 


TRIAZOPHOS TECHNICAL CONCENTRATES — 


SPECIFICATION 
(First Revision ) 


1 SCOPE 


This standard prescribes the requirements and the 
methods of sampling and test for triazophos, 
technical concentrate. 


2 REFERENCES 


The following Indian Standards contain provisions 
which through reference in this text, constitute 
provisions of this standard. At the time of 
publication, the editions indicated were valid. All 
standards are subject to revision, and parties to 
agreements based on this standard are encouraged to 
investigate the possibility of applying the most 
recent editions of the standards indicated below : 


6940 : Methods of test for pesticides and 
1982 their formulation (first revision) 


8190 (Part Requirements for packing of 
2) :1988 pesticides — Part 2 Liquid 
pesticides (second revision) 


10946 : Methods of sampling for technical 
1996 grade pesticides (first revision) 
3 REQUIREMENTS 


3.1 Description 


IS No. Title The material shall be in the form of dark brown 
coloured liquid with typical phosphoric ester odour. 
1070 : Reagent grade water (third revision) Some suspended matter or turbidity may be present.

requirements given in Table 1.

IS 14936 : 2022 


5 MARKING 


5.1 The containers shall be securely closed and 
shall bear legibly and indelibly the following 
information in addition to any other information as 
required under the Insecticides Act, 1968 and Rules 
framed there under : 

a) Name of the material; 

b) Name and address of the manufacturer; 

c) Batch number; 

d) Date of manufacture; 

e) Date of expiry; 

f) Net quantity; 

g) Nominal triazophos content, percent 
(mim), 

h) Cautionary notice as worded in the 
Insecticides Act, 1968, and Rules framed 
thereunder; and 

j) Any other information required under the 
Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) 
Rules, 2011. 


5.2 BIS Certification Marking 


The product(s) conforming to the requirements of 
this standard may be certified as per the conformity 
assessment schemes under the provisions of the 
Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 and the Rules 
and Regulations framed thereunder, and the 
products may be marked with the Standard Mark. 


6 SAMPLING 


Representative sample of the material shall be 
drawn according to IS 10946. 


7 TESTS 


7.1 Tests shall be carried out by the methods 
referred to in col (4) and (5) of Table 1. 


7.2 Quality of Reagents 


Unless specified otherwise, pure chemicals and 
distilled water (see IS 1070) shall be employed in 
tests. 


NOTE — “Pure chemicals” shall mean chemicals that do not 
contain impurities which affect the results of analysis. 


ANNEX A 


IS 14936 : 2022 


[Table 1, SI No. (i)] 


Determination of Triazophos Content 


A-1 GENERAL 


HPLC method shall be used for estimating 
triazophos content. 


A-2 HIGH PERFORMANCE LIQUID 
CHROMATOGRAPHY 


A-2.1 Principle 


A High Performance Liquid Chromatography 
(HPLC) unit with a ultraviolet (UV) detector is used 
for determination. A solution containing known 
amount of triazophos standard and solution 
containing known mass of triazophos sample is 
injected to obtain respective peak areas. The 
percentage of triazophos in sample then computed 
by standard relationship. 


A-2.2 Apparatus 
A-2.2.1 HPLC Unit 


A suitable instrument equipped with a UV detector 
and a printer plotter-cum-integrator. The HPLC 
conditions suggested below can be changed in 
equipment employed, provided standardization is 
done: 


Column — Stainless steel 25 cm long, 4.6 mm 
i.d. packed with silica particle size 5 u (make E 
merek or waters). 


Detector — Ultraviolet. 
Wavelength — 254 nm. 
Flowrate — 2.0 ml/min. 
Sample size — 20 ul 
A-2.3 Reagents 
A-2.3.1 /so-Octane HPLC Grade 
A-2.3.2 1,4 Dioxane HPLC Grade 
A-2.3.3 Toluene HPLC Grade 
A-2.3.4 Water HPLC Grade 
A-2.3.5 Make Up Phase 


Mix iso-Octane, 1,4 Dioxane (before mixing the 
solvent, add 0.15 percent water in 1,4 Dioxane) in 
the ratio of 90 :10. 


A-2.3.6 Mobile Phase 


Mix iso-Octane, 1,4 Dioxane (before mixing the 
solvent, add 0.15 percent water in 1,4 Dioxane) in 
the ratio of 90 : 10. 


A-2.3.7 Triazophos reference standard of known 
purity (A standard of 60 percent LC with known 
active ingredient content only be used). 


A-2.4 Procedure 
A-2.4.1 Preparation of Standard Solution 


Weigh accurately standard to contain 110 mg of 
active ingredient in 50 ml volumetric flask. Add 10 
ml of toluene and dissolve it and make volume up to 
the mark with make up phase (A-2.3.5). Take out 5 
ml of this solution with pipette into another 25 ml 
volumetric flask and make up to the mark with make 
up phase (A-2.3.5). 


A-2.4.2 Preparation of Sample Solution 


Weigh accurately sample to contain 110 mg of 
triazophos active ingredient in 50-ml volumetric 
flask. Add 10 ml oftoluene and dissolve it and make 
up to the mark with make up phase (A-2.3.5). Take 
out 5 ml of this solution with pipette into another 25 
ml volumetric flask and make up to the mark with 
make up ‚phase (A-2.3.5). 


A-2.4.3 Estimation 


Inject 20 ul of standard solution into HPLC unit 
peak area of two successive injections agree within 
1 percent. Then inject 20 ul of sample solution into 
HPLC unit to obtain the pack area. 


A-2.4.4 Calculation 


At X Mi 
As X M2 


Percent triazophos = x P 


where 


At = area of triazophos in unknown sample; 
As = area of triazophos in reference standard; 
Mı = mass, in ml, of reference standard; 
M» = mass, in ml, of unknown sample; and 


P = triazophos content in standard.

Bureau of Indian Standards 


BIS is a statutory institution established under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 to promote harmonious 
development of the activities of standardization, marking and quality certification of goods and attending to 
connected matters in the country. 


Copyright 


BIS has the copyright of all its publications. No part of these publications may be reproduced in any form without 
the prior permission in writing of BIS. This does not preclude the free use, in the course of implementing the 
standard, of necessary details, such as symbols and sizes, type or grade designations. Enquiries relating to 
copyright be addressed to the Head (Publication 8 Sales), BIS. 


Review of Indian Standards 


Amendments are issued to standards as the need arises on the basis of comments. Standards are also reviewed 
periodically; a standard along with amendments is reaffirmed when such review indicates that no changes are 
needed; if the review indicates that changes are needed, it is taken up for revision. Users of Indian Standards 
should ascertain that they are in possession of the latest amendments or edition by referring to the website- 
www.bis.gov.in or www.standardsbis. 


This Indian Standard has been developed from Doc No.: FAD 01 (19382).
